entries.name: Chaos Knight
lines: Chaos Bolt can stun Night Stalker outside of Crippling Fears relatively small radius.
Reality Rift is a great way to force Night Stalker to fight Chaos Knight, a hero with massive health and damage output. It also forces Night Stalker's Crippling Fear off his primary target.
Night Stalker doesn't have a lot of ways to deal with multiple targets, which makes him vulnerable to Phantasm illusions unless Night Stalker buys Aghanim's Scepter.

entries.name: Lycan
lines: Void's slow is useless against Lycan by activating Shapeshift.
Night Stalker's single target abilities (with the exception of Void upgraded by Aghanim's Scepter) is not very effective against Lycan's Summon Wolves during the early and mid game.

entries.name: Naga Siren
lines: Ensnare and Song of the Siren prevents Night Stalker from escaping and ganking during daytime or even nighttime.
Rip Tide reduces Night Stalker's armor, making him easier to focus down.
Mirror Image can be effective against Night Stalker, due to his single target abilities.

entries.name: Phantom Lancer
lines: Void's slow is dispelled by Doppelganger or counteracted by Phantom Rush.
Spirit Lance's and Diffusal Blade's slow reduces Night Stalker's mobility and helps him or his ally escape if they're inflicted by Void or Crippling Fear.
Night Stalker has no AoE abilites to take out Phantom Lancer's illusions. Even if Night Stalker gets an Aghanim's Scepter, there will be way too many illusions for Night Stalker to handle.

entries.name: Sven
lines: Warcry makes it difficult to burst Sven down with both the passive (with Aghanim's Shard) and active component.
Sven under the effect of God's Strength and his massive physical damage make Sven very dangerous to engage in the mid game.

entries.name: Troll Warlord
lines: Whirling Axes (Melee) provides a 60% miss chance, which can make the attack speed bonus from Hunter in the Night largely ineffective.

Berserker's Rage together with Battle Trance and Fervor stacks gives him a high chance of rooting Night Stalker, which allows Troll Warlord to man-fight Night Stalker in any stage of the game, regardless of whether or not it's night.
Night Stalker is not a common Monkey King Bar carrier to counteract this problem.
Phoenix turns night to day, overriding Dark Ascension during Supernova.
Blood finding's Rupture turns Night Stalker mobility against him and Thirst grants movement speed bonus and vision prevents Night Stalker from initiating and re-initiating.
Heroes that are hard to gank: Fairy Knight, Pantheon, Centaur Warrunner.
Heroes with illusions and summons can manfight Night Stalker: Terrorblade, Beastmaster, Broodmother.
Heroes with stronger lane presence that can threaten to kill him: Batrider, Juggernaut, Ursa, Monkey King, Razor.
Heroes that can punish aggressive heroes, such as: Leshrac, Shadow Demon, Pugna, Death Prophet.
Town Portal Scroll is an easy way to escape Night Stalker after Void is used if you can survive his followup physical attacks.
Manta Style dispels Void's slow, as well as creating illusions that can waste his single-target abilities but doesn't stop you being silenced by Crippling Fear.
Lotus Orb sends Void's slow back to him or removes the debuff from an ally.
Linken's Sphere prevents Void's slow and damage.
Force Staff brings targets out of Crippling Fear's area.
Ghost Scepter or Ethereal Blade prevents Night Stalker attacking on you or an ally.
Eul's Scepter of Divinity wastes Night Stalker's Crippling Fear duration.
Silver Edge breaks Hunter of the Night.
Black King Bar provides spell immunity, making Crippling Fear and Void useless.

entries.name: Storm Spirit
lines: Storm Spirit is absolutely helpless if caught within Night Stalker's silence range.
Common items a Storm Spirit will build will not remove the AoE silence.

entries.name: Puck
lines: Puck cannot use any of its normal means to survive should Night Stalker catch it within Crippling Fear, and goes down quickly.

entries.name: Clinkz
lines: The long silence at night prevents Clinkz from escaping with invisibility if Night Stalker can sneak up on him. He also has really low base health, so Night Stalker can usually kill him alone during one cast of Crippling Fear at night.

entries.name: Earthshaker
lines: Fissure has a short stun and creates an impassable ridge. However, Night Stalker can fly over it during Dark Ascension.
Night Stalker can find Earthshaker, disable his Blink Dagger with Void, and then take him out with Crippling Fear.
Earthshaker may fail his blink combo against Night Stalker's team if he is not careful, as he can blink into the silence.

entries.name: Keeper of the Light
lines: Keeper of the Light's Aghanim's Scepter upgrade loses much of its power, due to Night Stalker being able to reduce the duration of daytime by a lot.

entries.name: Tinker
lines: Night Stalker is one of the best heroes to find (and silence) Tinker in the trees during Dark Ascension.

entries.name: Riki
lines: With Dark Ascension and Gem of True Sight, Night Stalker can easily find and kill Riki. Riki will also find it harder to kill the tanky Night Stalker than he would many other heroes.

entries.name: Slark
lines: With Dark Ascension he can keep vision on Slark, disabling his Shadow Dance regeneration.
Night Stalker is very fast so without the Pounce in lane, he can simply out distance him during the night.
Slark is matched in night vision by only a few heroes, Night Stalker happens to be one of them.
Heroes with weaker mobility will struggle to keep up with Night Stalker: Gyrocopter, Ursa, Drow Ranger
Heroes with low health: Lich, Crystal Maiden, Lion.
Heroes that have a weak laning stage: Spectre, Nyx Assassin, Clockwerk, Spirit Breaker, Omniknight, Pudge.
Heroes with low mobility that rely on spells: Thor, Lina, Crystal Maiden.

entries.name: Oracle
lines: Fortune's End counters the abilities of some heroes that are strong against Night Stalker in lane, such as Batrider's Sticky Napalm, Ursa's Overpower and Monkey King's Jingu Mastery. It roots Razor and Ursa in place when you need to run from them. This spell is also an additional source of interrupting teleports, and on a low cooldown.
Fate's Edict counters Juggernaut's Blade Fury, and while Blade Fury is on cooldown, Fate's Edict and Fortune's End will combine to prevent Juggernaut from trading back or disengaging.
Oracle's combo of Fortune's End and Purifying Flames helps finish off targets within the duration of Crippling Fear.

False Promise can be amplified beyond its normal ability to save, as Night Stalker has a lifesteal talent and also likes to make Satanic. The delayed damage may also enable you to run somewhere where it is safe to teleport away from Rupture, while preventing Thirst from triggering as well.

entries.name: Luna
lines: Eclipse turns day into night for 10 seconds while Dark Ascension grants Luna the bonus vision while active, which is minor but neat - although used effectively, it can help make up for Night Stalker's downtime in crucial situations. But Luna is also able to clear the illusions and minions that Night Stalker doesn't like, and Lunar Blessing increases Night Stalker's damage.

entries.name: Magnus
lines: Reverse Polarity places all enemy heroes into a small area, lining the enemy team up for Crippling Fear.
Empower helps Night Stalker farm easily. Empower also helps compensate for Night Stalker's lack of wave clearing, and lets him deal better with illusions and summons.
Heroes that make up for Night Stalker's potentially lackluster team fighting so the draft is stronger overall: Medusa, Elder Titan, Ogre Magi...

Heroes that are tanky enough to help draw the enemy's attention, allowing Night Stalker to do his job of sneaking up on and cleaning out the enemy's backline heroes: Medusa, Fairy Knight, Wraith King...

Heroes with bonus night vision get an advantage when Night Stalker uses Dark Ascension: Bounty Hunter, Luna, Lycan, Slark. However, this is likely to be quite minor as Night Stalker wants to save the spell for fights during which he'll provide vision for the team anyway.

entries.name: Tango
lines: Tango gives health regeneration to stay alive.

entries.name: Healing Salve
lines: Healing Salve restores health in the early game.

entries.name: Enchanted Mango
lines: Enchanted Mango restores mana so Night Stalker may use one more Void in the early game to secure kill.

entries.name: Regular Stick
lines: Regular Stick doesn't store charges that restore HP and mana for Night Stalker.

entries.name: Boots of Speed
lines: Boots of Speed, combined with Hunter in the Night, increase Night Stalker base movement speed, granting him unparalleled mobility at night.

entries.name: Urn of Shadows
lines: Urn of Shadows fits the active Night Stalker, giving him charges that heal or hurt heroes. It also increases mana regeneration and armor so Night Stalker can stay alive to contribute to ganks.

entries.name: Observer Ward
lines: Observer Ward grants vision so Night Stalker can set up ganks; his high mobility at night makes placing wards deep inside enemy territory easy.

entries.name: Magic Wand
lines: Magic Wand is very situational depending on how fast you need other items, and whether you need it in general.

entries.name: Solar Crest
lines: Solar Crest gives Night Stalker solid stats all around and a powerful debuff for ganking.

entries.name: Phase Boots
lines: Phase Boots grant Night Stalker extra movement speed and attack damage, synergizing well with Hunter in the Night's movement and attack speed boost.

entries.name: Spirit Vessel
lines: Spirit Vessel gives great health and movement speed while giving the ability to deal with heroes with heavy healing capabilities.

entries.name: Aghanim's Shard
lines: Aghanim's Shard grants Night Stalker the ability to farm for only 1400 gold.

entries.name: Assault Cuirass
lines: Assault Cuirass gives Night Stalker both offensive and defensive power. The extra armor makes him much tankier, synergizing well with his high strength growth, and the attack speed bonus combines with the enemy armor reduction to greatly improve Night Stalker's and teammates' physical damage output.

entries.name: Butterfly
lines: Don't underestimate how strong Butterfly with Satanic can be on a hero who has a very strong ultimate with very strong talents for right clicking.

entries.name: Abyssal Blade
lines: Abyssal Blade helps Night Stalker lock down targets with stun and bash; its damage block and bonus health also add to his tankiness.

entries.name: Black King Bar
lines: Black King Bar makes Night Stalker immune to most disables in team fights so he can focus on using abilities and attacking the enemies without interruption; it also gives him more health and attack damage.

entries.name: Lotus Orb
lines: Lotus Orb gives Night Stalker a blend of self-sustain and survivability through the health and mana regeneration. The active applies dispel which can be very useful against several heroes or just to help sustain your team.

entries.name: Smoke of Deceit
lines: Smoke of Deceit helps Night Stalker get crucial kills by masking his and allies' presence from enemy wards.

entries.name: Gem of True Sight
lines: Gem of True Sight reveals invisible enemies and wards. Combined with Dark Ascension unobstructed vision during nighttime, Night Stalker commands great vision over the map.

entries.name: Blink Dagger
lines: Blink Dagger allows Night Stalker to initiate easily as it enables him to pounce on unsuspecting enemies and making him a force to be reckoned with due to the swift movement speed granted from Hunter in the Night and the silence from Crippling Fear. This can be upgraded to Overwhelming Blink, applying a magical burst whilst slowing any enemies in his catch, bolstering his presence especially in the late game.

entries.name: Blade Mail
lines: Blade Mail's Damage Return can keep Night Stalker alive as enemies may choose not to deal any damage to him, lest losing HP themselves.

entries.name: Heaven's Halberd
lines: Heaven's Halberd's disarm works well with Crippling Fear's silence to completely prevent an enemy from fighting back. It also increases survivability with bonuses to strength, evasion, and status resistance.

entries.name: Nullifier
lines: Nullifier this item can be considered in anticipation of the enemies building BKB, which would allow them to cast spells under Night Stalker's 2nd ability. It's also good against enemies who depend on items like Manta Style + Skull Basher like Anti Mage, Spectre, etc. and since the projectile is slow Nullifier would be good to pair with Blink Dagger or Shadow Blade (If the enemy depends on his passive ability better upgrade to Silver Edge).

entries.name: Silver Edge
lines: Silver Edge gives Night Stalker bonuses to attributes, attack speed, and attack damage. Shadow Walk, combined with Hunter in the Night, allows him to gank while moving at maximum speed, inflicting bonus damage and break to ruin enemy powerful passive abilities.

entries.name: Bloodthorn
lines: Bloodthorn for a Night Stalker can be considered thanks to its high bonus attack speed whilst allowing Night Stalker to cast another silence onto a fleeing enemy and refining his hitting power thanks to its active providing 130% critical strike on every attack that cannot be missed.

entries.name: Heart of Tarrasque
lines: Heart of Tarrasque greatly increases the size of Night Stalker's health pool, making him much harder to bring down in fights. The extra strength gives him more base damage as well, and the passive health regeneration makes staying active on the map easy.

pros: Excellent night vision allows Night Stalker to control the map and scout to jump on an unsuspecting lone hero, or spot and retreat from enemy ganks.
Bulky right from the beginning of the game.
Very threatening presence during the night.
Great for hit and run/gank tactics.
playstyle.text: Night Stalker is a strong early game ganker during the night. Void is a neat ability that deals good damage and slows the target. During nighttime, the slow lasts much longer, and Void also applies a mini-stun. Crippling Fear silences all enemies near him and lasts much longer during night, making it extremely useful for ganks. Hunter in the Night gives Night Stalker bonus movement and attack speed when it's night time, allowing him to be very mobile. Dark Ascension instantly turns day to night while giving Night Stalker a large amount of extra benefits over most heroes, including the ability to fly. If left unchecked, Night Stalker can snowball by getting kills after kills in the early game and controlling the map in the mid to later stages of the game with great night vision. However, his effectiveness is heavily dependent on night, and none of his targeted spells pierce spell immunity.
cons: Weak in team fights due to the lack of strong area of effect abilities.
Weak during daytime, forced to play around night time.
Has no answer to spell immunity.
Has a vision range of 800 during the day compared to the standard 1800.

lines: There are generally two ways to play Night Stalker in the offlane and both of them include a similar laning stage where you want to strive for having as much impact during the night time including with your ultimate, Dark Ascension.

Night Stalker is a noticeably slow farmer so you will want to buy items that allow you to get kills. Picking with heroes who offer a slow or reliable way of disable can be a great way to put up multiple early kills.

Void should always be maxed first as the nuke damage and slow durations scales well. At level 4, getting Hunter in the Night could be a good idea if the enemy team has no way to escape from you during the night.

Aghanim's Scepter used to be extremely good on Night Stalker as a way to stay relevant with farming, but now his Aghanim's Shard does that just as well, making it mostly redundant unless you are against very specific illusion based heroes.

Balanar suffers from a small mana pool so buying items to sustain it, such as the Aghanim's Shard and Echo Sabre, are a very good idea. The most ideal situation at night time is you can run in and the enemies cannot fight back.

As mentioned above there are two main ways to play Night Stalker depending on what your mid game and late game goals are. You can either go down the route of building items that help your teamfighting capabilities like Heaven's Halberd, Spirit Vessel and so on. Or you can buy items such as Black King Bar, Butterfly, Satanic which make you more than just a fast hero who kills supports.
Which one you choose from above really depends on the teams. If your team lacks carry ability, it might be a good idea to be a secondary carry if you can afford these expensive items.
You will be surprised how fast you can farm with the Aghanim's Shard if you haven't tried it yet.

Unlike other heroes in the game, Night Stalker has below-maximum sight range in the daytime, with only 800 compared to most other heroes' 1800. However, he more than compensates for this by possessing 1800 night vision, a value only equaled by a few other heroes in the game and more than double the rest. This means that while Night Stalker is relatively easy to sneak up on and gank in daylight, he possesses powerful vision at night, which can allow him to use his abilities to the utmost.
Become active during nighttime and gank the enemies as Night Stalker is at his peak then. Save the farming for daytime.
On top of having high mobility, Night Stalker has high strength, making him ideal at diving towers.

Oftentimes, Night Stalker can play support as his abilities offer great disables during ganks and he does not need many items to work. Once he has some levels and the first night arrives, he comes online and should find kills for his teammates.

In occasions, Night Stalker can be a strong solo mid laner. His excellent base damage and high base health allow him to get last hits and denies reliably, and he benefits greatly from solo experience as he can take advantage of the levels once the first night hits. Furthermore, being mid gives him the option of ganking either top or bottom without the need for a Town Portal Scroll, as he can reach either lane quickly due to Hunter in the Night.
Void deals damage and slows the target's movement speed.
Max Void first as it gives you a decent way to be useful even during daytime and stronger at nighttime.

When laning, Night Stalker may choose to leave Void at level 1 while holding on the skill points until ganks. Doing so will preserve its low mana cost so Night Stalker can use it more to get difficult last hits.
Void stuns its target during nighttime, so Night Stalker can use it to cancel Town Portal Scroll to stop enemies escaping.
Void's low cooldown makes it a strong spell for breaking Linken's Sphere on an enemy. This can pave the way for allies to use additional disables on the target.
Crippling Fear is a very good silence at level 1, maxing his other spells is a very good idea first for the mobility and damage.
In fights with multiple enemies, try to stick Crippling Fear on enemy casters or supports in order to remove their presence.

While weak in the daytime, Crippling Fear can still buy a small window of opportunity if use on the right target. Even though Night Stalker is relatively weak during daytime, he can still disable the enemy with his abilities if forced to.
This ability is why building items such as Phase Boots on Night Stalker is a very good idea, to keep on top of people and stop them escaping.
Max this spell second as it gives Night Stalker much needed mobility and attack speed at night, enabling the hero very hard.
Hunter in the Night empowers Night Stalker's attack speed and movement speed during the night, making him a powerful ganker during the majority of the game.

With Phase Boots, max level Hunter in the Night will boost Night Stalker's movement speed to nearly haste speed of 550. Use this speed to your advantage to chase down enemies or escape with near impunity.
Most noticeably, this ability instantly will turn day into night for 30 seconds. Does not stack if it's already nighttime.

Dark Ascension can be most profitably cast whenever it is off cooldown during the daytime. By doing so, you effectively reduce the amount of daytime there is in the game, as daytime will continue to tick down during Dark Ascension.
At night, use Dark Ascension to gank for its increased attack damage.
Dark Ascension's flying vision allows Night Stalker to see enemies in the trees.
With True Sight, Dark Ascension's flying vision helps Night Stalker spot enemy wards or stealth heroes.
Dark Ascension enhances Night Stalker's mobility by letting him fly over cliffs.

notes.text: Move Speed bonus changed from 22/28/34/40% to 24% + 2% per 3 levels
Attack Speed bonus changed from 20/40/60/80 to 38 + 2 per level
No longer upgraded with Aghanim's Shard
Increases bonus Movement Speed by 15% and bonus Attack Speed by 50. Killing an enemy hero resets cooldowns of all basic abilities
Now affects all units within 400 radius around the target
No longer upgraded with Aghanim's Scepter
New basic ability. Has both passive and active components
Night Stalker heals himself 6/8/10/12 health when attacking enemy units
Attacks on allied units and buildings will not heal Night Stalker
Can be cast at night to eat a non-ancient creep and restore 10/15/20/25% of Night Stalker's maximum health and 10/12/14/16% of his mana. Cast Range: 125. No Mana Cost. Cooldown: 39/36/33/30s

hero.text: Removed Heart of Darkness innate ability

talents.text: Level 10 Talent +5s Dark Ascension Duration replaced with +10 Crippling Fear DPS
Level 20 Talent +40 Crippling Fear DPS replaced with +75 Crippling Fear Radius
Level 25 Talent +100 Hunter in the Night Attack Speed replaced with +100 Midnight Feast Lifesteal

hero.text: Heart of Darkness: No longer reduces Night Stalker's health regeneration by 20% during the day

talents.text: Level 20 Talent Crippling Fear DPS increased from +20 to +40

bio:
Of the Night Stalker, there is no history, only stories. There are ancient tales woven into the lore of every race and every culture, of an impossible time before sunlight and daytime, when night reigned alone and the world was covered with the creatures of darkness--creatures like Balanar the Night Stalker.

It is said that on the dawn of the First Day, all the night creatures perished. All, that is, save one. Evil's embodiment, Night Stalker delights in his malevolence. He created the primal role of the Night Terror, the Boogeyman, and as long as there have been younglings, his is the specter summoned to terrify them. This is a role he relishes; nor are these empty theatrics. He does indeed stalk the unwary, the defenseless, those who have strayed beyond the lighted paths or denied the warnings of their communities. Night Stalker serves as living proof that every child's worst nightmare....is true.

wikiNotes.text: Uses the nighttime values during the night, and from the following sources:
The nighttime of Dark Ascension and Eclipse.
Within the Void Zone radius.
Void first applies the movement speed slow debuff, the damage, the stun debuff, then creates the Void Zone.
Has a cast backswing of 0.73 when the passive component of Hunter in the Night is active during nighttime.
Turns Void into an area-targeted ability affecting all enemy units within 450 radius.
Does not target invisible units or units inside the Fog of War within the radius.
With the cast range and effect radius, Void can hit units up to 975 range away.
0.4 seconds after cast, the Void Zone created provides an aura that grants all of Night Stalker's abilities the nighttime bonuses within the radius.
Unlike nighttime, the Void Zone created neither lingers nor modifies the Time of Day in any way.
Each created Void Zone has its own independent duration.
Night Stalker does not benefit from Rubick's Void Zone.

notes: Void does not ministun enemies during the day.
abilities.description: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.
abilities.name: Void
abilities.shard: Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.

wikiNotes.text: Uses the nighttime values during the night, and from the following sources:
The nighttime of Dark Ascension and Eclipse.
Within the Void Zone radius.
Both the damage per second and silence are provided by an aura, its debuff lingers for 0.5 seconds.
Although the damage per second component does not affect invulnerable and hidden units, the silence debuff fully affects them.
Deals 2.5/3/3.5/4 damage in 0.1-second intervals, resulting in 35 and 50/55/60/65 damage instances for daytime and nighttime respectively.
Can deal up to 87.5/105/122.5/140 or 125/165/210/260 damage to a single unit (before reductions) when the affected unit stays in range for the entire duration.
Does not update the current instance when the time of day turns daytime or nighttime while active.

abilities.description: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him.  The effect lasts longer at night.
abilities.name: Crippling Fear

notes: Amount of health gained from attacking is affecting by Health Restoration and is decreased when attacking non-hero targets.
abilities.description: Night Stalker heals himself when attacking enemy units. At night, the ability can be activated to instantly destroy a non-ancient creep and restore a percentage of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana.
abilities.name: Midnight Feast

wikiNotes.text: Grants passive bonuses only during nighttime, and from the following sources:
The nighttime of Dark Ascension and Eclipse.
Within the Void Zone radius.
Adds an active component to Hunter in the Night, with the passive effects still present.
Can be cast on any unit except for heroes, wards and buildings.
Treats illusions, clones, creep-heroes and Roshan as heroes.
Cannot be cast on ancient creeps during daytime, but can during nighttime.
The targeted creep is instantly killed, granting its gold and experience bounties if it was an enemy, denying it if it was an ally.
Despite the visual effect, the health and mana restored are applied instantly upon cast.
The active has a minimum cast range of 150 despite having a different value in the game files.
Stacks multiplicatively with other status resistance sources.
The acquired ability is a passive ability on Rubick if he does not have Aghanim's Shard equipped.

abilities.scepter: Increases bonus movement speed by 15% and attack speed by 50. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.
abilities.description: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.
abilities.name: Hunter in the Night

wikiNotes.text: Time of Day modifying abilities has the following priorities: Supernova ➤ Eclipse ➤ Dark Ascension.
The ability's bonuses are not disabled during Supernova's daytime. However, the vision is limited to Night Stalker's default daytime vision.
Eclipse does not interfere with the nighttime caused by Dark Ascension in any way — they do not cancel or pause each other's nighttime.
Upon cast, the hero model and hitbox of Night Stalker ascends 150 units above the z-axis.
However, its collision size is still on the ground. This does not change the current absolute coordinates of the model as well.
Grants flying vision based on the caster's current vision range for its duration.
For Night Stalker, Dark Ascension grants 1800 flying vision.
Resets the current cooldowns of all the caster's basic abilities upon cast.
Neither reset ultimate abilities nor item abilities.
Does not reset charges for charged-based abilities.
Destroys trees within a 150 radius at the end of the duration.
Always replaces the game clock's daytime or status with Night Stalker's minimap icon regardless of the caster.
Rubick neither ascends above the z-axis nor turns into a flying unit.

abilities.description: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.
abilities.name: Dark Ascension

name: Night Stalker
short: Enpowered by the shadows of nightfall
